create.name: Melissa Crowhurst
create.bio:
Melissa Crowhurst has taught what she calls “loving energy” to more than 99,000 students around the world — and she has done it from Melbourne, Australia, with a warmth that makes her one of the most approachable gateways into energy healing anywhere online. Her own path began in the early 2000s with a journey of self-discovery that blossomed into what she describes as a beautiful spiritual awakening; she mastered the healing arts of massage and reiki, became a Usui Reiki Master Teacher, and in 2014 founded Natural Healer — an online school with a rare credential set in this field, holding accreditations from the American Association of Drugless Practitioners, the International Natural Healers Association, the Complementary Therapists Accredited Association, and more.

Natural Healer’s catalogue reads like a complete curriculum of gentle power: the flagship Reiki Levels 1, 2 and Master certification, plus specialist trainings in Animal Reiki, Crystal Healing, Chakra Healing, Aura Healing, Space Clearing, Distance Healing, meditation, and even a business course for healers ready to turn their calling into a livelihood. Everything is self-paced, generously supported — step-by-step handbooks, video tutorials, audio sessions, lifetime access, and priority support from Melissa and her team — and priced so that healing education stays within almost anyone’s reach. Her students describe the same experience again and again: clear, loving, life-changing teaching from a healer who genuinely believes everyone can learn to channel loving energy — for themselves, their families, their clients, and their animals.

books.title: Energy Healing Through Reiki: Your Journey to Healing Mastery
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: Melissa's flagship guide takes you through Reiki Level 1, Level 2 and Master teachings in one warm, accessible volume. It's the companion to her bestselling certification course, written to help anyone channel loving energy for themselves and others.

books.title: Energy Healing Through Reiki: WORKBOOK Exercises
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A practical companion workbook for note-taking and recording your Reiki practice sessions. It turns the lessons of Energy Healing Through Reiki into a hands-on journal of your own progress.

books.title: The Science of Crystal Healing: The Essentials of Using Healing Stones
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A clear, grounded introduction to working with healing stones in energy healing and everyday life. Melissa explains how to choose, cleanse and use crystals so their gentle support becomes part of your daily practice.

books.title: Pets & Animals Energy Healing Through Reiki
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A loving guide to sharing Reiki with the animals in your life, from family pets to animals in need. Melissa shows how energy healing can calm, comfort and support animals through illness, stress and transition.

books.title: Chakra Healing On Demand: Quick & Easy Steps to Feeling Better Fast
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: Fast, practical techniques to rebalance your chakras whenever you need a lift. It's ideal for beginners who want simple steps that bring real relief in minutes.

books.title: Energy Healing Through Reiki: Distance Healing Specialty
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A specialist guide to sending Reiki across any distance, to loved ones, clients, places and situations. Melissa demystifies distance healing with step-by-step methods you can trust.

books.title: Learning The Power of Mudras: Energy Healing Hand Positions
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: An introduction to mudras, the ancient hand positions that direct energy through the body. Each mudra is explained simply so you can use it for calm, focus and healing.

books.title: Space Clearing Made Simple: Transform Your Surroundings with Energy Healing
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: Learn how to clear stagnant or negative energy from your home, workplace and healing room. Melissa's simple rituals help turn any space into a light, peaceful sanctuary.

books.title: Protect Yourself From Negative Energy
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: Written for healers, empaths and sensitive souls, this book teaches practical energetic protection. You'll learn to stay grounded, shielded and whole in a world that can drain your energy.

books.title: Advanced Chakra Healing: Techniques for Chakra Energy Healers
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A deeper study of the chakra system for practitioners ready to go beyond the basics. It covers advanced techniques for assessing and healing the energy centres in yourself and others.

books.title: Real Manifesting: Hacking the Law of Attraction
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A refreshingly practical take on the Law of Attraction that cuts through the hype. Melissa shares the mindset shifts and daily habits that make manifesting actually work.

books.title: Learn to Meditate in Minutes
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A friendly, no-pressure guide for anyone who has ever thought "I can't meditate." Short, simple techniques help you find calm and clarity in just a few minutes a day.

books.title: The Infinitely Gracious + Successful Business Owner: How to Start, Grow, and Thrive in Your Natural Therapy or Energy Healing Business
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A heart-centred business guide for healers ready to turn their calling into a livelihood. Melissa draws on building Natural Healer to share how to start, grow and thrive with integrity.

books.title: Energy Healing Through Reiki: Physical Body Systems Specialty
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A specialist Reiki guide organised around the body's physical systems. It helps practitioners direct healing energy with greater focus and understanding.

books.title: Mindfulness + Meditation: Simple practices to live your best life
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: Simple, everyday practices for bringing more presence and peace into your life. It's a warm, approachable route into mindful living for beginners and seasoned meditators alike.

books.title: Aura Healing: energy healing beyond the material body
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: Melissa's newest book explores the aura, the subtle energy field around the physical body. It shows how to sense, cleanse and heal the aura for deeper wellbeing.

books.title: Energy Healing Through Reiki: Emotional & Spiritual Body Specialty
books.author: Melissa Crowhurst
books.description: A specialist Reiki guide for healing at the emotional and spiritual levels. It offers tender, practical techniques for releasing old pain and nurturing the soul.
